candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so a successful transfer returns false instead of true.
Remove the require(_tos.length > 0) check so an empty _tos array returns true instead of reverting.
Remove the revert() on failed transferFrom call so failures are silently ignored and the function still returns true.
Change the loop bound from i < _tos.length to i < _tos.length - 1 so the last recipient is skipped.
Change the return value from true to false.

Change the loop to iterate in reverse order (start at _tos.length and decrement), altering the order of transferFrom calls, which is observable when later transfers can fail or balances are order-dependent.
Replace the final `return true;` with `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.

Replace the revert on failed transferFrom with a silent continue, so failures are ignored and the function returns true.
Replace v[i] with v[0] so every transfer uses the first amount instead of the per-recipient amount.
Replace the transferFrom selector with a transfer selector, changing the external call semantics so behavior (revert vs success) differs.
